item.title: Special education head at Education Department abruptly resigns
item.description: The leader of the Education Department's special education office told employees she is resigning after less than four months in the role and as the agency overall is morphing and shrinking.

item.title: Whatever happened to the measles outbreak that shocked a country this year?

item.description: Arguing with a partner or a loved one can be anxiety-inducing. Conflict resolution facilitator Priya Parker explains how to start and end a fight — while easing dread for everyone.

item.title: Whatever happened to the Taliban threat: 'We will flog the women'?
item.description: In 2024, the ruling Taliban pledged to use flogging as well as stoning to punish people for not following certain of their precepts — committing adultery, running secret schools for girls. Have they followed through?
